methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The single-family building, located in the northern part of Italy

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Exclusive focus is a residential single-family NZEB house (a new single house building) with no industrial component; it reports building energy-performance monitoring against a national-methodology (UNI/TS 11300) design calculation rather than a characterised EnPI/EnB relevant-variable model. Excluded under the 'residential buildings without industrial component' rule.

paper_type.evidence_quote: An exemplary building, designed in 2010, has been considered as a case study

stage1.notes: Single-family NZEB house, N. Italy; 6-year monitoring vs UNI/TS 11300 semi-stationary design calc; real winter consumption ~79% of simulated, classed PEB. Reports EP indicators (EPgl,tot, EPH,nd) but no fitted EnB/relevant-variable model. Residential, no industrial component -> ineligible.
